description: Specifies the document state in the workflow
values: Entry level: newly imported; awaiting initial review
Entry level or end state: already retained elsewhere
Midstream: basic check of automatic data (type/scope/location/etc.)
Midstream: check later on (stays in checking process, but not as important)
End state: defer indefinitely; deprecated use; mark for check in distant future (Jewish location but no specifically Jewish names seen, or else too difficult to read)
